entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes. I want to return these terrible shoes right now!
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, and I can help you today. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. Could I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Alex Smith, order number 88-512-9003. And let me be clear, I'm not looking for help, I'm looking for my money back. These cycling shoes you sold me are absolute garbage.

Okay, Alex, I'm pulling up your order now. I see you purchased the VeloPro cycling shoes, delivered 38 days ago. I'm really sorry they aren't working out. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?

The issue is they're giving me horrible blisters! After every single ride! I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, I've tried different socks, nothing works. They're just poorly made. I want a refund, and I want it now. If I don't get it, I'll make sure every cycling forum on the internet knows about this.

I completely understand your frustration. Getting blisters on a ride is the worst, and I apologize that's been your experience with our gear. Let me just quickly review the return eligibility for this item.
Don't give me the runaround! I know my rights. Just process the return. If you can't do it, put your manager on the phone right now.

There's no need for that, Alex, I can handle this for you. I've just confirmed our policy. For standard items like these cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return window. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process a full refund for you today.
Wait, really? A full refund? No restocking fee or some other trick?

No tricks at all. A full refund to your original payment method. I'm generating a prepaid return shipping label and sending it to the email address on your account right now. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, the refund process will begin.
Oh. Okay. Well... that's... good. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. The email has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure that email comes through.
It will. Again, my apologies for the trouble with the shoes. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better day.
